observations: Three identical black and silver HP ProDesk small form factor desktops stacked on a cardboard box.
Each unit has 'hp' logo and 'PRODESK' text on the front panel (photo 0, photo 1).
Intel Core i3 sticker visible on top of each unit (photo 0, photo 1).
Stickers also show 'Intel Core i3 7th Gen' and 'Windows 10 Pro' (photo 1).
Front panel ports: two USB ports, headphone/mic jacks, and power button (photo 0, photo 1).
Rear panel ports: VGA, DisplayPort, multiple USB, Ethernet, and power input (photo 2).
Units show minor scuffs and dust, especially on top surfaces (photo 1).
Box underneath has shipping symbols and 'NICK MARK ENTERPRISE' watermark (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).
